Danelectro Billionaire Cash Cow Overdrive Distortion Pedal $40.00 $79.99 Add to cart SKU: JWR603979698430 Category: Guitar Effect Pedal More info Shipping Reviews The Danelectro Cash Cow OD Distortion Pedal delivers massive sounds on a budget. Best known for its classic rock and blues tones, this pedal packs a wide variety of tones into a durable all-metal shell with vintage-inspired looks. Despite being on the affordable side of overdrive pedals, the Cash Cow offers exceptional definition throughout its entire range of volume, gain, and EQ settings. It is surprisingly quiet and does not produce feedback or clicking like you would expect from a budget pedal. Turn up the gain for that classic breakup sound and crank it even higher for sizzling lead tones or heavy rhythms. Alternatively, low-gain and high-volume settings create a wonderfully boosted tone that is not quite transparent but adds a really nice bit of color and punchy grit. The treble and bass controls can be adjusted to dial in your signature sound or compensate for different in amps.
